Working notes: order intake
- Required form v1 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.
- Each intake batch is an attempt (1–3). After 3 rejected attempts, record goes to manual review; move to next.
- Accepted outcome (+1.00); rejected outcome (-0.20) lists invalid fields. Use prior invalid-field list to target next attempt, but recheck all fields—previously valid fields can regress if omitted.
- Never submit empty/partial did. Carry forward known valid cust/email/order_date. Logs truncate did; missing from displayed JSON is not proof.
- Priority is the most common invalid field (nearly every rejection). Ship_country often invalid; qty sometimes. cust/email/order_date usually valid when present.
- Source reliability: "Customer called to confirm"/phone typed can fix some fields (e.g., ship_country) but not priority. Handwritten transcription and emailed orders vary; partner portal not automatically reliable.
- Observed: Dee Reyes ORD-5106 rejected priority, ship_country; ORD-5107 accepted after corrections. Eli Okafor ORD-5109 still invalid priority after ship_country fixed. Bo Okafor ORD-5104 invalid priority only; ORD-5105 empty/partial rejected cust/email/qty/ship_country—preserve valid fields.
- Strategy: extract all six fields from full source; on retry fix previous invalid fields; preserve prior valid fields; ensure complete before final attempt.

Working notes: order intake
- Forms v1/v2 require same six fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.
- Batch = attempt (1–3). After 3 rejected, manual review; next record. Rejected -0.20 lists invalid fields; accepted +1.00.
- On retry target prior invalid fields but recheck all; prior valid can regress if omitted/truncated. Do not submit empty/partial did. Carry forward known valid cust/email/order_date. Logs truncate did; missing from displayed JSON is not proof of invalid.
- Priority remains most common invalid; often only invalid. “Marked ordinary priority by intake team” and source/forwarder labels did not fix it (ORD-5115–5119, 5112–5113). It may still need correct explicit value; prior ORD-5107 accepted after corrections.
- Ship_country next most common (ORD-5110, 5113); qty only in blank/partial. cust/email/order_date usually valid when present.
- Forwarder claims—“duplicate done,” “new,” “customer confirmed,” “ordinary priority,” “partner portal”—not reliable; check actual source record. Source labels can mismatch (ORD-5113 said portal, source was voicemail). Phone/email/handwritten/portal vary; none auto-fix priority.
- Recent: Eli Okafor ORD-5110 attempt3 emailed, invalid ship_country only -> manual. Ada Sato ORD-5114 blank/partial rejected cust/email/qty/ship_country; ORD-5115/5116 invalid priority -> manual. Eli Marsh ORD-5117–5119 all invalid priority -> manual. Eli Marsh ORD-5112 priority; 5113 priority+ship_country -> manual.
- Strategy: extract all six from full source; fix prior invalid; preserve prior valid; ensure complete before final. If priority still invalid or source lacks it, expect manual review after attempts.
